text.p: Crude oil tanker rates were little changed in most sectors on Tuesday in a very quiet New Year's Eve market, brokers said.
"The market is basically closed," one broker said.
"It's very difficult to know the precise rate because very little is going on," another added.
One broker put cross-Med fuel oil 25,000 tonners at W175-W180, well down from W192.5-W200 last week, due to the seasonal lull. UK-Cont fuel oil was at much the same level for this tonnage, he said.
Mideast-West crude was unchanged at W55 for 250,000 tonners, and Mideast-Singapore was also at W55 for the same tonnage.
West Africa-U.S. Gulf was likewise level at W62.5 for 260,000 tonnes, and few if any changes were seen in the Caribs/upcoast market.
Only one transatlantic fixture was reported, the Tito Tapias loading 133,000 tonnes from the North Sea to USAC at W88 for Sun on January 11.
